source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Fuel, p.6M-10

procedures.title: Throttle linkage: Corvette layout (figure 12C)
steps: Use figure 12C in the manual to identify the Corvette throttle linkage parts when adjusting or replacing them.
327 and 427 (except 3x2): the throttle cable runs from the firewall along the engine to a bracket and the carburetor throttle lever, with a return spring at the bracket (View C).
427 with 3x2 carburetors: the cable connects at the rear carburetor and rods link the three carburetors (Views A and B); the left-hand linkage is shown and the right-hand side is opposite.
